Meta.title: Okhana — Family. Together. Always.
Meta.description: Okhana is an AI-powered family hub: shared notes, reminders, and a private assistant that only sees what each person is allowed to see.
Meta.ogDescription: Family. Together. Always. Keep your household in sync with a privacy-first AI assistant.

Home.headline: Your family hub, guided by AI
Home.pitch: Shared notes, reminders, and an assistant that only sees what each person is allowed to see — privacy at the source, not in the prompt.

onboarding.title: Set up your family space
onboarding.subtitle: Create a new family for your household, or join one with an invite code from someone who already uses Okhana.
onboarding.chooseCreateDescription: You'll get an invite code to share with partner, kids, or relatives.
onboarding.chooseJoinDescription: Someone in your family already created a space — enter their code.
onboarding.createDescription: Pick something everyone will recognize — you can change it later.
onboarding.joinDescription: Ask your family owner for the code from their Okhana dashboard.
